Social Affairs Committee

Agenda

Meeting: 17th meeting
Venue: Committee Room 12
Date: 20 October 2026 (Tuesday)
Time: 10:30

1. Work relating to the bill and resolution submitted to the committee

1.1 Extending the deadline for the bill on the 1st amendment to Law No. 4/2012 (Thalassaemia Control Act), sent back by the President for the People's Majlis to reconsider.

1.2 Extending the deadline for the resolution submitted by the Member for North Galolhu constituency, Mohamed Ibrahim, noting that foreigners married to Maldivians and living in the Maldives do not receive Aasandha services, in order to find out the views of Members of the People's Majlis on the matter.
